title: Inter- and Intraobserver Variability in Bowel Preparation Scoring for Colon Capsule Endoscopy: Impact of AI-Assisted Assessment Feasibility Study.
summary: TransUNet segmentation/classification estimated visible mucosa and automated CC-CLEAR scores for 25 videos; nine readers’ paired standard and AI-assisted assessments found AI did not improve agreement (bootstrapped Fleiss .14 vs .27; ICC .59 vs .69) and was less reliable for less-experienced readers. Small feasibility study with a negative result.
